# Choose a project writing workflow

Select the appropriate writing workflow without requiring callers to understand the entire collection.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use on explicit request to choose a writing workflow; ordinary writing can select its specialist directly.

Example request:

> Choose the right workflow for explaining a decision and announcing the resulting feature.

Expected result: A purpose-specific route, with separate artefacts where readers have different needs.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** The requested artefact is an announcement. An accepted decision record supplies the governing choice and constraints.

**Before**

> Load every writing and architecture guide before drafting the announcement.

**After**

> Use marketing guidance for the announcement. Consult the decision record for the accepted choice and its constraints.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.7.0 --skill write-project-content
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/write-project-content/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/write-project-content/references/routing.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.

## Practices behind this skill

This locally authored compatibility workflow selects the appropriate writing skill for an explicit request. It gives agents access to relevant guidance without requiring every writing task to activate the entire collection.

- [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification)
- [Diátaxis](https://diataxis.fr/start-here/)

The [source-to-guidance map](../../standards/framework-evidence.md) explains how these sources inform the skill and which decisions are local.
